_original_lore: The Batty Witch can only spawn during the,
Spooky Festival and from Trick or Treat boxes.
This enemy spawns bats that follows a player
name: 蝙蝠女巫 (怪物)

source: The Batty Witch can only spawn during the,
Spooky Festival and from Trick or Treat boxes.
loreParagraphs.translation: 蝙蝠女巫只能在幽灵节期间生成,或从不给糖就捣蛋盒子中出现.

source: This enemy spawns bats that follows a player
loreParagraphs.translation: 该敌人会生成蝙蝠,蝙蝠会跟随玩家并在其身上爆炸.
